title: The same object farther away
hook: Change distance and predict small angular diameter.
misconception: small angular diameter doubles when distance doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply angle ≈ diameter/distance to compare small angular diameter when distance changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a fixed physical diameter much smaller than the distance, angle ≈ diameter/distance. When distance doubles, small angular diameter becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model angle ≈ diameter/distance; scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a fixed physical diameter much smaller than the distance, with a nonzero initial result. If distance triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on small angular diameter?
recall.why: Apply angle ≈ diameter/distance under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
